memory_updates: predicted actions only; no GT correction/reclustering/oracle prototypes for pseudo-Novel
supervision: policy_train pseudo-Novel Train category labels for target/action-risk loss only
architecture: Identical DecisionMLP 17 causal scalar candidate features -> Linear32 GELU -> Linear4;708 trainable parameters
candidate_rule: Top Known ID and top existing predicted anonymous token, plus NEW and WAIT; unavailable candidates masked
prefix_schedule: cap=prefix_cycle[(epoch-1+order_index)%5]; independent capped-prefix replay, WAIT unresolved at cap, not dense frame controller
D1_loss: inverse-category-frequency weighted nominal action cross entropy
D2_loss: same nominal CE plus expected cost under predicted action probabilities, and delayed penalty to prior predicted write when a later top candidate has actual absorbing mixed-category history
GT_history: external training target/risk bookkeeping only; no category/role/identity enters MLP or visual memory; no oracle correction
checkpoint_selection: development-only mean H-score and correct Commit-CT at zero WAIT bias over all five prefixes/main order; ties earlier epoch; all checkpoints kept
operating_point_selection: development-only nearest effective commitment coverage on fixed pseudo-Novel cross-video reuse opportunities; tie lower total action error then smaller absolute WAIT bias; report total commitment coverage too; no interpolation or matched claim unless both coverage gaps<=0.05
